title: Eloquent Models: Conventions aur Setup
objectives: Table, primary key aur timestamps ki conventions jaanna

sections.heading: Eloquent ORM kya hai?
sections.body: ORM matlab Object-Relational Mapper. Eloquent mein database ki har table ke liye ek **Model** class hoti hai, aur table ki har row ek **object** hoti hai. Tum SQL ki jagah `Product::where(...)->get()` jaise PHP code se kaam karte ho. Query builder ke saare methods yahan bhi milte hain, upar se timestamps, relationships, casts jaise features.

callout.text: Query builder row ko `stdClass` deta hai. Eloquent `Product` object deta hai jisme apne methods aur behaviour ho sakte hain.

sections.heading: Model banana
sections.body: `make:model` model banata hai. Flags se saath mein migration, factory aur seeder bhi ban jaate hain.

code.code:
php artisan make:model Product
php artisan make:model Product -mfs   # migration, factory, seeder bhi
php artisan model:show Product

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class Product extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;
}

explain: `Product` model automatically `products` table se baat karta hai.
`model:show Product` table ke columns aur model ki details dikhata hai.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Conventions
sections.body:
Eloquent convention follow karta hai, isliye bahut kuch likhna nahi padta:

- Model `Product` -> table `products` (snake_case, plural)
- Primary key `id` (auto-increment)
- `created_at` aur `updated_at` columns apne aap bharte hain

Isse bina config ke yeh kaam karta hai:

sections.heading: Conventions customize karna
sections.body: Legacy table ya alag naming ho to model mein batao:
explain: Properties (`$table`, `$primaryKey`, `$timestamps`) sab versions mein chalti hain.
Laravel 13 docs mein yahi config class attributes (`#[Table]`) se bhi likh sakte ho. `#[Table]` table naam ke saath key, keyType, incrementing, timestamps, dateFormat jaise named arguments leta hai.

versionDiff.heading: Model configuration: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: Model ka core behaviour teeno versions mein same hai. Laravel 13 mein configuration ke liye optional PHP attributes aaye hain.

items.13: Properties abhi bhi chalti hain. Saath mein `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes` ke attributes (`#[Table]`, `#[Fillable]`, `#[Hidden]`, `#[Visible]`) optional tareeka hain. Purane code ko badalna zaroori nahi.

errors.error: SQLSTATE[HY000]: General error: 1 no such table: products
errors.cause: `products` table bani hi nahi (migration chali nahi) ya model ka table naam galat hai.
errors.fix: `php artisan migrate` chalao ya `$table` sahi karo.

errors.cause: Model file nahi bani ya namespace galat hai.
errors.fix: `make:model Product` chalao aur `use App\Models\Product;` check karo.

errors.error: Attempt to read property "name" on null
errors.cause: `find(1)` ya `first()` ne null diya (row nahi mili).
errors.fix: Null check karo (`?->`), ya `findOrFail()` use karo.

debug.body: Model aur table ka match dekhne ke liye `model:show` aur Tinker sabse aasan hain.

code.code:
php artisan model:show Product
php artisan tinker
>>> App\Models\Product::first()

tasks: `php artisan make:model Product -mf` chalao aur migration mein columns bharo
Model mein `$table` ko galat naam do aur error dekho, phir theek karo

quiz.q: `Product` model kaunsi table use karta hai?
Timestamps band karne ke liye kya karte hain?

interview.a: Database tables ko PHP model classes se map karne wala Laravel ka ORM, jahan har row ek object hoti hai.

interview.q: Model aur table ka naam kaise map hota hai?
interview.a: Convention se: `Product` -> `products`. Alag ho to `$table` property.

interview.q: Eloquent aur Query Builder mein farak?
interview.a: Eloquent models, timestamps, relationships, casts jaise features deta hai. Query builder seedha table par SQL-jaisi chaining hai.
Jab table mein `created_at`/`updated_at` columns nahi hote.
Model ke table, columns, relationships ki summary dikhata hai.

summary: Eloquent: har table ka model, har row ek object.
`make:model -mfs` model ke saath migration, factory, seeder.
Conventions properties se (ya Laravel 13 attributes se) badal sakte ho.
Tinker se model ko turant try karo.
